name: Hello OpenCode
description: An extension-contributed ACP adapter that connects to OpenCode CLI via stdio JSON-RPC. Demonstrates how to wrap an existing ACP-compatible CLI as an extension adapter.

descriptionI18n.zh-CN: 通过扩展贡献的 ACP adapter，使用 stdio JSON-RPC 连接 OpenCode CLI。展示如何将现有的 ACP 兼容 CLI 包装为扩展 adapter。

name: Hello CodeBuddy
description: An extension-contributed ACP adapter that loads CodeBuddy Code CLI via 'vx npx'. Demonstrates how to use npx-based CLI packages as extension adapters with vx environment management.

descriptionI18n.zh-CN: 通过 'vx npx' 加载 CodeBuddy Code CLI 的扩展 ACP adapter。展示如何使用 vx 环境管理加载基于 npx 的 CLI 包。
